answer: Hardware-rooted attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to sign a challenge inside an isolated enclave, verified via a vendor-chained quote with a chip-unique pseudonym. Because secrets are fused into a silicon crystal die, deploying extra agents for a farm trellis or a transit atlas forces attackers to buy distinct chips per identity rather than cloning VMs. However, side-channel extraction or compromised vendor keys can let one host forge many identities.
